name: Transit App API
tagline: Multi-city public transit directions and realtime arrivals for developers.
description: Transit App exposes multi-city public transit directions, schedules, and realtime vehicle/stop data for use in third-party applications. Coverage spans many North American and international cities where the consumer Transit app operates, with endpoints for trip planning and live arrivals. Access is typically partner or API-key based rather than fully self-serve for all features.

auth.details: API key required; contact Transit for access. Exact header/query scheme not fully public on marketing page.

pricing.paid_plans: Partner/commercial pricing; not publicly listed in detail

use_cases: get nearby transit routes for a lat/lon
plan multi-modal transit trips between two points
fetch realtime arrivals at a stop
show live vehicle positions on a map
list agencies and coverage for a city
